title: Access and memory of a method

questions.stem: Per this page, who can call a class method declared with no access modifier at all?

options.text: Code in other packages too, as with a public method
options.says: The page says no modifier means package-private, not public.

options.text: Code in the same package, as with a package-private method
options.says: The page says a method with no access modifier is package-private.

options.text: Code in the same class, as with a private method
options.says: The page says no modifier means package-private, which is wider than private.

questions.stem: Per this page, what does creating a new object allocate, as far as its class's methods go?

options.text: Its instance fields, and no method code at all
options.says: The page says method code is loaded once with the class, and only instance fields are allocated per object.

options.text: Its instance fields, and each instance method's code
options.says: The page says creating an object does not load or copy any method.

options.text: Its static fields, and each static method's code
options.says: The page says creating an object does not load or copy any method, static or instance.
